															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025: Physical Standard Test (Male)

															
																
																Height: The minimum requirement is 170 cm, which is relaxable by 5 cm. A reduced height requirement of 165 cm applies to residents of specified Hill areas (like Garhwalis, Gorkhas, Dogras, etc.), candidates from certain North-Eastern states, ST candidates, and sons of serving, retired, or deceased Delhi Police personnel/Multi-Tasking Staff.
																
																
																Chest: The minimum requirement is 81−85 cm with a mandatory minimum expansion of 4 cm. And 5 cm relaxation in chest measurement is available for residents of the specified Hill areas, ST candidates, and sons of serving, retired, or deceased Delhi Police personnel/Multi-Tasking Staff.
																
															

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025: Physical Standard Test (Male)

															
																
																Height: The minimum requirement is 157 cm, which is relaxable by 5 cm. 																Chest: Not Required
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025: Physical Endurance Test (Male)

															
																
																Candidates up to 30 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 7 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 12.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3.5 feet.
																
																
																Candidates above 30 to 40 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 8 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 11.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3.25 feet.
																
																
																Candidates above 40 years must complete the 1600-meter race in 9 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 10.5 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3 feet.
																
															

															 

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025: Physical Endurance Test (Female)

															
																
																Candidates up to 30 years must complete the 800-meter race in 5 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 9 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 3 feet.
																
																
																Candidates above 30 to 40 years must complete the 800-meter race in 6 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 8 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 21/2 feet.
																
																
																Candidates above 40 years must complete the 800-meter race in 7 minutes, clear a Long Jump of 7 feet, and achieve a High Jump of 21/4 feet.

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Salary 2025

															The Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Salary 2025 falls under the Level 4 pay scale with a salary range of ₹25,500 – ₹81100/- plus Grade Pay ₹2400. The pay structure is as per the 7th Pay Commission. Along with the basic pay, selected candidates will receive Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travelling Allowance (TA), and Ration Pay provided by the Government.

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Admit Card 2025

															The Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Admit Card 2025 will be released 15 days before the exam date. As per the SSC Exam Calendar 2025, the written test for Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Recruitment 2025 will be conducted in November–December 2025. Candidates can download their admit card from the official SSC regional websites.

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Answer Key 2025

															The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will release the Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Answer Key 2025 for the Computer-Based Test (CBT) within 15 days after the exam. First, a provisional answer key will be published, followed by the final answer key on the official SSC website. Candidates can check and raise objections (if any) before the final release.

															Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) Result 2025

															The Delhi Police Head Constable (AWO/ TPO) 2025 will be declared once the exam is successfully conducted. Candidates can check their results by roll number and name on the official SSC portal – ssc.gov.in.

															
																
																Those who qualify the cut-off marks will be eligible for the next stage of recruitment.
																
																
																After the Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (PEMT), the final merit list will be published on the official website.
